sinopsis.es: Tras 75 años de espera, Atlético Bucaramanga conquista su primera estrella. A través de hinchas de distintas generaciones, barristas y líderes comunitarios, el documental retrata cómo el fútbol transformó heridas, recuperó esperanzas y unió a toda una ciudad alrededor de una celebración largamente soñada.
sinopsis.en: Atlético Bucaramanga waited 75 years for its first Colombian league title, won on penalties in June 2024. The film follows that season through the club's supporters: a 60-year-old man who promises to have the crest tattooed on his chest, a 90-year-old grandmother, a teacher working to keep children away from crime, former barra members who left violence behind, and the city that adopted the Cumbia de los trapos as its anthem.
